questions.passage: There are plenty of introverts who lead a psychologically rich life. The type of intellectual journey that Alison Gopnik had is available to introverts who seek new intellectual knowledge. Likewise, Joy Ryan went to so many national parks with her grandson Brad. Led by someone like Brad, introverted people might do something unusual.
questions.prompt: What role does the statement about 'plenty of introverts' play?
questions.promptZh: 关于 plenty of introverts 的陈述起什么作用？
options: It proves that extraversion has no association with richness.
It reinforces that the personality relationships allow many exceptions.
It says all introverts have identical experiences.
It reverses the definition of richness into happiness alone.
optionsZh: 证明外向性与丰富完全无关。
强调人格关系允许许多例外。
说所有内向者经历完全相同。
将丰富定义反转成只有幸福。
analyses: A 有例外不等于统计关联为零。
B 许多内向者也丰富，承接非决定性关系。
C plenty 不是所有，也不说经历相同。
D 没更改维度定义，后面给思想探索与引领体验的途径。

vocabulary.context: 表数量充足而非全部，不提供确切百分比。
vocabulary.example: There are plenty of ways to approach the problem.

questions.translation: 有许多内向者过着心理丰富的人生。对寻求新知识的内向者，Alison Gopnik 那种思想探索之旅同样可行。同样，Joy Ryan 和孙子 Brad 去了许多国家公园。有像 Brad 那样的人引领，内向者也可能做不同寻常的事。

questions.passage: It should be noted that conscientiousness, agreeableness, and emotional stability are secondarily predictors of a rich life. That means that you can set a goal to be open to new experiences and conscientiously work on that goal and lead a psychologically rich life. You can be agreeable to your friend’s and partner’s suggestions for a new adventure and expand your horizons. There really are numerous ways to lead a psychologically rich life.
questions.prompt: Which use of other personality traits does the author recommend?
options: Rejecting a partner’s suggestions to protect every existing routine.
Treating emotional stability as proof that new experiences are unnecessary.
Working conscientiously toward openness and accepting suggestions for adventure.
Waiting for all personality traits to become perfect before exploring anything.
questions.promptZh: 作者建议怎样运用其他人格特质？
optionsZh: 拒绝伴侣建议以保护所有惯例。
把情绪稳定当成不必有新经历的证明。
认真努力地提高开放性，并乐于接受冒险建议。
等所有人格特质完美后才开始探索。
analyses: A 原文 be agreeable to...suggestions 是接纳，不是拒绝。
B 第二层预测因素不排除新体验。
C conscientiously work 与 be agreeable 分别说明怎样利用尽责和宜人倾向。
D 没有先完美再行动的条件；作者强调 numerous ways 而非单一资格。

evidence.quote: be agreeable to your friend’s and partner’s suggestions for a new adventure

vocabulary.context: 指通过新冒险增加理解与经历，不是字面的地平线移动
vocabulary.example: Studying an unfamiliar art form can expand your horizons.

questions.translation: 还应注意，尽责性、宜人性和情绪稳定性也是丰富人生的次要预测因素。这意味着，你可设定对新经历开放的目标，认真努力追求它，过心理丰富的人生。你也可以接纳朋友和伴侣提出的新冒险建议，拓展眼界。过心理丰富人生的方式确实很多。

questions.prompt: Which traits are described as secondary predictors of a rich life?
questions.promptZh: 哪些特质被描述为丰富人生的次要预测因素？
options: Only openness and extraversion, with every other trait excluded.
Conscientiousness, agreeableness, and emotional stability.
Intellectual ability, family income, and height.
Only worry and complete rejection of new experiences.
optionsZh: 仅开放与外向，排除所有其他特质。
尽责性、宜人性、情绪稳定性。
智力、收入与身高。
仅担忧及完全拒绝新经历。

B 原句三项完整对应。
C 不符此处列出的特质。
D 不是原文，secondary 也不等于完全无用；保留原页 secondarily 的措辞不改正文。

questions.passage: Who is happy? Extraverts and emotionally stable people tend to lead a happy life perhaps in part because they tend to have good relationships and find something positive in most situations. Conscientious people tend to be happy as well, perhaps because they tend to achieve their goals, whereas agreeable people tend to be happy in part because they have warm, conflict-free relationships with others.
questions.prompt: How strongly are the explanations for happiness presented here?
options: As the single proven cause of every happy life.
As partial explanations, with some explicitly qualified by “perhaps”.
As evidence that agreeable people never face disagreement.
As a denial that goal achievement has any relationship with happiness.
questions.promptZh: 本段以多强的确定程度解释幸福？
optionsZh: 每种幸福人生唯一且已证实的原因。
部分解释，其中一些明确用 perhaps 限定。
证明宜人者从不遭遇任何分歧。
否认目标实现与幸福有任何联系。
analyses: A tend、perhaps、in part 均避免唯一和必然。
B 两处 perhaps 和 in part 表明这是部分、带限定的机制解释。
C warm, conflict-free relationships 是作者描述的倾向，不是每个人永无冲突。
D 作者确实把目标实现作为尽责者可能更幸福的解释之一。

evidence.quote: perhaps because they tend to achieve their goals

vocabulary.context: 限定解释范围，说明关系质量或积极态度不一定是全部原因
vocabulary.example: The delay was caused in part by bad weather.

questions.translation: 谁幸福？外向且情绪稳定的人往往过幸福人生，或许部分因为他们往往拥有好关系，也能在多数处境中发现积极之处。尽责者也往往幸福，或许因为他们往往实现目标；宜人者往往幸福，部分因为他们与他人拥有温暖、少冲突的关系。

questions.prompt: What does the question 'Who is happy?' introduce in the summary?
questions.promptZh: 总结中的 Who is happy? 引出什么？
options: A tentative explanation of happy-life personality patterns through relationships and positive outlook.
A ranking of all named people from happiest to least happy.
A claim that every agreeable person avoids every disagreement forever.
Proof that conscientiousness guarantees achievement of every goal.
optionsZh: 从关系和积极看法解释幸福人格模式，并保留推测。
将所有被点名人物按幸福高低排名。
断言每个宜人者永远无分歧。
证明尽责性保证实现每个目标。
analyses: A tend to、perhaps、in part 限定后面的关系及目标解释。
B 没有列人物幸福排名。
C warm,conflict-free 是模式描述，不是 every 与 forever。
D tend to achieve 非所有目标保证，句意是总结解释而非决定性规律。

questions.passage: In short, openness to experiences represents the most striking difference between the personality correlates of a psychologically rich life and those of a happy and meaningful life. Whereas openness to experience plays a relatively minor role in happiness and meaning, it plays a major role in a psychologically rich life. Personality research on psychological richness reveals that there is a path to a good life via being open to new experiences.
questions.prompt: What is identified as the most striking difference among the personality correlates?
questions.promptZh: 人格相关因素中最显著的区别被归于什么？
options: Openness to experiences.
Emotional stability.
Conscientiousness.
Agreeableness.
optionsZh: 经验开放性。
情绪稳定性。
尽责性。
宜人性。
analyses: A openness...represents the most striking difference 直接点名，后句比较其在三维中的相对作用。
B 情绪稳定性在前文属于幸福与意义的重要相关因素，非本句最突出差异。
C 尽责性有助目标与其他维度，但不是此处所点名差异。
D 宜人性也有相关作用，不能替换句中开放性；correlates 不等于唯一决定原因。

vocabulary.meaning: 相关因素；呈相关联系的变量
vocabulary.context: 名词复数，区别于已确定的单向原因。
vocabulary.example: The study examined the correlates of regular attendance.

questions.translation: 总之，在心理丰富人生与幸福、有意义人生的人格相关因素之间，经验开放性构成最显著的区别。它对幸福和意义的作用相对较小，对心理丰富人生却作用重大。关于心理丰富性的人格研究显示，接纳新经历是通往美好人生的一条道路。

questions.passage: A lesson from personality psychology, then, is that it is important to know who you are (you can take a Big Five personality test on my website!). It is also important to know which personality traits are associated with each dimension of a good life. Harness this understanding of our personality and the personality traits associated with psychological richness, happiness, and meaning to develop strategies for achieving the good life.
questions.prompt: What practical use does the author propose for personality knowledge?
options: Use self-understanding and trait–life associations to develop strategies for a good life.
Use a personality score to assign every person a fixed destiny.
Take one test as a substitute for any later personal effort.
Choose the same life strategy regardless of any differences in personality.
questions.promptZh: 作者建议怎样实际运用人格知识？
optionsZh: 利用自我认识及特质与人生维度的关联，制定美好人生策略。
用人格分数给每个人分配固定命运。
做一次测试就替代此后所有努力。
无论人格怎样不同，都采用完全相同策略。
analyses: A know who you are 与 traits...associated 后，用 Harness...to develop strategies 明确用途。
B 不是定命运；本章前文已保留非决定性。
C 测试只是认识自己的一种提示，没有替代努力的承诺。
D 文中强调理解人格和不同人生维度，非抹掉差异。my website 归于书中作者，本网站不自动代做或跳转测试。

questions.passage: The following chapters give some tips for how we all can incorporate a bit of psychological richness into our everyday lives. Even if you are neurotic, disagreeable, unconscientious, introverted, and closed to new experiences, personality can change with effort. Don’t give up. Keep on reading!
questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the final encouragement to “Keep on reading”?

To introduce practical tips while stressing that personality can change with effort.
To claim that reading alone instantly changes every personality trait.
To announce that the book has finished discussing psychological richness.
questions.promptZh: 结尾鼓励 Keep on reading 的用意是什么？
optionsZh: 坚持只有原本高开放性者才能获益。
引出实际方法，并强调人格能随努力改变。
宣称只读文字就能立刻改变所有特质。
宣布全书已结束心理丰富性的讨论。
analyses: A Even if 后列出相反特质，仍鼓励继续。
B following chapters give some tips 与 change with effort 共同说明继续读的理由。
